item.title: Fatherhood Diaries: a thousand questions
item.description: The children are growing up too fast. I’m glad they are healthy and developing as expected, but I’m just not ready. My oldest, Johnny, is turning nine today. Like Schrödinger’s cat, he is both a child and a pre-teen. He sometimes exhibits behaviours of such intensity and disproportionality only expected of teenagers, while other times he is going out of his way to kiss and hug me, still craving my attention in that sweet, childish, nurturing kind of way.
